title: Mixed tensor-unit normalization of the strict integral direct-image scalar comparison
statement:
Let $k$ be a field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, $\Omega$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-proper-morphism]. For every finite subextension $H\subset\Omega$ choose its valuation ring $R_H=\mathcal O_H$, uniformizer $t_H$, and quotients $A_{H,n}=R_H/t_H^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use small pro-etale sites and completed coefficient sheaves $\widehat R_{H,W}=\varprojlim_n(A_{H,n})_W$, for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $\mathcal C_H(W)=D^b_c(W,R_H)$ for the derived-complete bounded constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Let $I_H=Rf_{*,H}:\mathcal C_H(X)\to\mathcal C_H(Y)$ be the strict-tower direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Its reduction comparison $r^H_{n,K}:(I_HK)_n\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{*,A_{H,n}}K_n$ is the adjunct of the actual total-limit projection, with $K_n=K\otimes^L_{\widehat R_{H,X}}(A_{H,n})_X$ [lem-sf-integral-direct-image-constructible, lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction].

For $E\subset L$ let $T_W=T^W_{L/E}$ be completed integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Let $b_*:T_YI_E\xrightarrow{\sim}I_LT_X$ be the inverse of the integral comparison in [lem-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-comparison]: thus it is the ambient completed-ring counit/tensor mate transported through the normalized reconstruction comparisons and the canonical ordinary-to-completed scalar maps. Put $A=A_{E,n}$, $B=A_{L,n}$, $\phi_n:A\to B$ for the induced quotient-ring map, and $\operatorname{Res}_{\phi_n}$ for exact restriction of scalars. Let
$$\eta_{W,n,M}:M_n\longrightarrow\operatorname{Res}_{\phi_n}(T_WM)_n$$
be the mixed completed reduction unit [def-weil-mixed-reduction-unit], using $n-1$ for that definition's nonnegative index. Under the canonical coherent identification $(T_WM)_n\cong M_n\otimes_A^LB$ of [lem-pur-coefficient-extension-reduction-model], this is the universal scalar-extension unit. Let $\rho_{*,n}:Rf_{*,A}\operatorname{Res}_{\phi_n}\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_{\phi_n}Rf_{*,B}$ be the normalized ordinary restriction comparison [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars].

For every $K\in\mathcal C_E(X)$ the following equality holds as a morphism of $A_Y$-module derived objects:
$$\operatorname{Res}_{\phi_n}\!\left(r^L_{n,T_XK}\circ(b_{*,K})_n\right)\circ\eta_{Y,n,I_EK}
=\rho_{*,n,(T_XK)_n}\circ Rf_{*,A}(\eta_{X,n,K})\circ r^E_{n,K}.$$
Equivalently, $r^L_{n,T_XK}\circ(b_{*,K})_n$ is the unique $B_Y$-linear lift of the displayed right side through the universal source tensor unit. These normalizations hold simultaneously as an equality of morphisms of coherent derived quotient systems, including their quotient transitions and derived scalar-association comparisons, with the actual reduction/total-limit unit and counit of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. They do not assert that an arbitrary family of evaluated equalities detects a derived system morphism. No flatness of $\phi_n$ or uniform finite Tor-amplitude of $K_n$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0B56, equation-projection-formula-map (counit-transpose construction); agent-extracted coherent mixed-quotient normalization of the reconstruction-transported comparison in lem-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-comparison, using the specified system units and counits.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-strict-mixed-system-models] to obtain actual reduction calculi, coherent scalar models, normalized limit and restriction comparisons, all their finite evaluations, strict projections, and invertible reduction maps. These do not yet include the scalar mixed-unit square.

Use the scalar-linear equation of [lem-weil-strict-mixed-scalar-square]. Apply the scalar-adjunction Hom equivalence. Its naturality moves S_Y(r_E) to precomposition by r_E, and its inverse cancels on q. Expand the Hom equivalence as unit followed by restriction of the map. Naturality of the restriction/direct-image comparison then moves the source coefficient isomorphism across direct image. Cancel its invertible restricted direct image. This gives the mixed-unit equation on entire systems. In Lean this is scalar_square_unit, proved by the Hom-equivalence identities, functoriality and cancellation.

The map sending z to mixedUnit followed by restriction(z) is exactly the composite of precomposition by the inverse coefficient reduction isomorphism with the scalar-adjunction Hom equivalence. Both factors are equivalences, so the map is bijective; this is the proved helper mixedUnit_bijective. Package these results with the constructed witnesses to obtain CoherentLaws.
Apply [lem-weil-strict-mixed-finite-evaluation] to the constructed CoherentLaws. Pair its FiniteLaws with CoherentLaws, proving the original conjunction unchanged.
